msg: Hi! I'm new here, can I sit next to you?
inner: You want to be close? How sweet.
say: "I'm not the only one, are you?" | "Tell me what to do. I'll punish you if you fail."

msg: You're really sweet, you know that?
say: I'm not so good at it. But I'll do my best. | Don't stop teasing me, okay? Or... or more?

inner: Oh no... he's saying it so loudly!
say: Y-yes, I love you too! Don't stop!

msg: I have to go now, bye.
inner: Don't leave yet! I want you here.
say: Just stay... don't go just yet. Or else. | You said it, didn't you? Now I get to enjoy the silence with you.

msg: What do you want to do today?
inner: I need to remind him of my feelings.
say: Let's play a game, okay? I'm going to make you jealous. | Who is it? Tell me his name right now!

msg: I got you a plush bunny!
inner: This is too good to be true. My heart races just thinking about it.
say: Hmph! You're the only one allowed to buy me things. | Tell me everything. Where did you get it? Did I choose you?
